practice.title: What we do
practice.intro: Four ways to work together. Each is outcome-led and scoped to the problem at hand.

lanes.title: Consulting Engagements
lanes.body: Defined projects with explicit scope and timeline. Strategic advisory, technology audits, transformation programs, AI deployment, and commercial operating models.

lanes.title: Advisory Roles
lanes.body: Formal advisory board positions with hospitality technology companies. Long-term relationships with regular cadence and strategic alignment.

lanes.title: Investor Support
lanes.body: Consultations for VC, PE, and corporate investors evaluating the hospitality technology sector. Due diligence, market mapping, and thesis validation.

lanes.title: Operating Ventures
lanes.body: Companies built under the Rosso Consulting umbrella. Each carries the parent endorsement while maintaining independent brand and commercial autonomy.

items.heading: Hotel Operators
items.body: Independent groups and family-owned operators. Technology strategy, AI deployment, distribution optimisation, and digital transformation.

items.heading: Hospitality SaaS Founders
items.body: Pre-seed to Series B founders building hospitality software. Go-to-market strategy, commercial scaling, product-market perspective, and operator insight.

items.heading: Investors
items.body: Funds evaluating travel and hospitality technology. Commercial due diligence, market intelligence, and operator validation.

items.heading: Peer Operators
items.body: C-suite peers and industry events. Speaking, thought leadership, and community contribution.

active.title: Advisory portfolio
active.intro: Current advisory roles with hospitality technology companies. Accepted only where there is genuine strategic alignment.
